summary: Form-associated rotary knob drawn as a dithered sphere with an arc of lit cells; set it by drag, scroll wheel or arrow keys.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value, clamped to `min`–`max` and snapped to `step`. Observed: a change moves the knob without events. Also the value a form reset restores.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Step size for drag, wheel and keys; a zero or negative step counts as 1. Its decimal places also set the displayed precision. Observed.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Text after the displayed value, for example ` dB`. Observed.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text under the value; also the slider `aria-label`. Observed.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. The knob ignores pointer, wheel and keys and leaves the tab order; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same. A disabled knob is not submitted.

events.name: input
events.description: Fires on every value change from drag, wheel or keys.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires on pointer release and on each wheel step or key press.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value. Setting it clamps and snaps without firing events; it is not reflected to the attribute. A value set before the first connect is kept.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Parsed `step`; a zero or negative step is 1.

accessibility: Sets `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext` (value with `unit`) on every change.
Pressing on the dial focuses it.
While disabled, the dial has `aria-disabled="true"` and `tabindex="-1"`.
motion: With reduced motion the indicator and arc jump to the value without the spring and the value text swaps without rolling.
form: Submits the current value as a string under `name`. No validation. Form reset restores the `value` attribute; a disabled knob is not submitted.
notes: Dragging sets the value from the pointer angle around the centre over a 270° sweep; it is not a vertical drag.
The wheel handler calls `preventDefault()`, so scrolling over the knob does not scroll the page.
The dial is fixed at 200 × 200 px. All attributes are observed.
